quarterly_data.signal: 10-K customer concentration (distributors not named): sales to distributors were 84% of fiscal 2025 revenue (89% in 2024, 87% in 2023) and two distributors accounted for approximately 69% of total revenue - Distributor A 30.9% (33.3% in 2024) and Distributor B 37.9% (31.2% in 2024); direct customers were 16.2%. Revenue from foreign sales was 83% of total; by ship-to location Greater China was 52% of 2025 revenue (40% in 2024). Backlog consists of orders from distributors and certain OEMs generally requiring delivery within the next year and has historically not been a predictor of future sales.
